name: Cudillero (Spain)
description: Divided by two diagonal lines into a blue hoist, a white central band and a green fly, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Cudillero (birds, a chequy bend and crossed tools on blue and white).
history: Municipal flag of Cudillero; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: broad white diagonal band from the lower hoist to the upper fly
Cudillero arms — birds, bend and tools
